name: dumbbell glute dominant bulgarian split squat
description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with a forward lean, loading the glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your back foot on a bench.
Step the front foot out far enough for your shin to stay near vertical.
Lower until the thigh is parallel.
Drive through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
